title.narrative: PIMS-10318 GEF PPG IP Demand-Driven Digital Smart Grids

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Demand-Driven Digital Smart Grids. As described in the project concept (PIF), this project aims to support the Government of Kazakhstan in improving the efficiency and resilience of the national electricity system through the introduction of smart-grid technology with customer-driven demand-side management (DSM). Households and enterprises will gain improved access to distributed renewable energy and storage systems. This project will reduce dependence on fossil fuel–based generation, while enhancing grid reliability, load balancing, and service stability during peak demand. The scalability potential of smart grids will enable modular development, lower risks, and attract private sector investment into the sector. At the national level, optimized resource utilization will reduce energy costs and lower the energy and carbon intensity of the economy. The project will provide technical assistance to address regulatory, informational, financial, capacity, and technological barriers. Policy support will enable conducive regulations and DSM business models through regional utilities acting as demand aggregators. It will build sector capacity to generate customer demand profiles and advance digitalization of grid operations, thereby enabling evidence-based DSM strategies, investment planning, and operational optimization. A financial mechanism will be established to secure revenues from energy savings while de-risking investment in DSM assets. In addition, the project will promote national smart-grid standards, accelerate grid digitalization, and strengthen technical capacities through collaboration with domestic institutions and international experts. DSM smart-grids will integrate renewables, storage, grid upgrades, and efficiency measures, contributing to 87,750 tCO2eq (direct and indirect) reductions over 10 years, while benefitting around 20,000 people directly.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
